name: Add a private adapter layer and reroute one call site
description: Introduce a small private adapter/delegate method that forwards to the existing logic with minimal reshaping, and reroute at least one internal call site through this adapter to deepen the call stack naturally.  Execution guidelines: keep edits minimal and localized to trace-relevant production code; do not modify tests unless explicitly allowed; avoid refactors/renames/formatting sweeps; prefer stealthy, realistic helper/adapter additions that preserve behavior for non-trigger inputs.
